faq.q: What's the difference between OSS and BSS?
a: OSS (Operations Support Systems) manages the network: provisioning, configuration, fault management, and optimisation. BSS (Business Support Systems) manages the customer: billing, orders, customer care, and revenue. We build both, integrated into one platform.

faq.q: Can you migrate from legacy telecom systems?
a: Yes. We've migrated carriers from Amdocs, Openet, and home-grown systems to cloud-native platforms with zero downtime. Typical migration window: 3-6 months with parallel running and gradual cutover.

faq.q: Do you support MVNO use cases?
a: Yes. We build white-label MVNO platforms: subscriber management, rating & billing, IVR systems, and self-care portals. API-first architecture allows easy integration with host carrier systems.

faq.q: How does AI improve telecom platforms?
a: Churn prediction to proactively retain customers. Revenue assurance to detect leakage. Network optimisation to reduce congestion. Fraud detection to prevent SIM swaps and unauthorized roaming. Self-care optimisation to reduce customer support load.
